title: Bram and the Autopsy
author: Silas Sandoval
blurb: Vesper Eastwick, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
